headline: More agents can still leave you doing all the coordination.
lede: Without a standing organization, every new session returns planning, routing, and risk decisions to the operator.

items.label: Direction
items.title: You narrate every next move
items.body: The agent can execute, but only while you keep the goal, context, and sequence in your own head.

items.label: Priority
items.title: The loudest session wins
items.body: Work is prioritized by whichever conversation is open, not by the mission and commitments above it.

items.label: Trust
items.title: You watch because intervention is unclear
items.body: If nobody knows where work should stop for you, delegation turns back into supervision.
